13: /**
14:  * Changes a task's status, and closes several tasks at once. Each action
15:  * checks the task's current status is the one it expects before writing the new
16:  * one.
17:  */
18: public class TaskActionServlet extends HttpServlet {
19: 
20:     private final TaskDao tasks = new TaskDao();
21: 
22:     @Override
23:     protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse resp) throws IOException {
24:         String action = req.getParameter("action");
25: 
26:         if ("bulkClose".equals(action)) {
27:             handleBulkClose(req, resp);
28:             return;
29:         }
30: 
31:         long id = Long.parseLong(req.getParameter("id"));
32:         Task t = tasks.findById(id);
33:         if (t == null) {
34:             resp.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND, "No such task");
35:             return;
36:         }
37:         String current = t.getStatus();
38: 
39:         switch (action == null ? "" : action) {
40:             case "start":
41:                 if (!guard(resp, current, TaskStatus.OPEN, action)) return;
42:                 tasks.updateStatus(id, TaskStatus.IN_PROGRESS);
43:                 break;
44:             case "submit":
45:                 if (!guard(resp, current, TaskStatus.IN_PROGRESS, action)) return;
46:                 tasks.updateStatus(id, TaskStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL);
47:                 break;
48:             case "approve":
49:                 if (!requireApprover(req, resp)) return;
50:                 if (!guard(resp, current, TaskStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL, action)) return;
51:                 tasks.updateStatus(id, TaskStatus.DONE);
52:                 break;
53:             case "reject":
54:                 if (!requireApprover(req, resp)) return;
55:                 if (!guard(resp, current, TaskStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL, action)) return;
56:                 tasks.updateStatus(id, TaskStatus.IN_PROGRESS);
57:                 break;
58:             case "reopen":
59:                 if (!guard(resp, current, TaskStatus.DONE, action)) return;
60:                 tasks.updateStatus(id, TaskStatus.OPEN);
61:                 break;
62:             default:
63:                 resp.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST, "Unknown action: " + action);
64:                 return;
65:         }
66:         if (!resp.isCommitted()) {
67:             // Optional: return to the focused task detail page (used by the
68:             // detail view's transition buttons). Default stays the list.
69:             String target = "detail".equals(req.getParameter("return"))
70:                     ? "/tasks/form?id=" + id
71:                     : "/tasks";
72:             resp.sendRedirect(req.getContextPath() + target);
73:         }
74:     }
75: 
76:     private void handleBulkClose(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse resp) throws IOException {
77:         String[] raw = req.getParameterValues("ids");
78:         if (raw == null || raw.length == 0) {
79:             resp.sendRedirect(req.getContextPath() + "/tasks");
80:             return;
81:         }
82:         long[] ids = new long[raw.length];
83:         for (int i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
84:             ids[i] = Long.parseLong(raw[i]);
85:         }
86:         tasks.bulkClose(ids);
87:         resp.sendRedirect(req.getContextPath() + "/tasks");
88:     }
89: 
90:     /** Authorization check for the approve and reject actions. */
91:     private boolean requireApprover(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse resp) throws IOException {
92:         Person user = (Person) req.getSession().getAttribute("user");
93:         if (user == null || !user.getRole().canApprove()) {
94:             resp.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN, "Approval requires a manager or admin");
95:             return false;
96:         }
97:         return true;
98:     }
99: 
100:     /** Refuse the change unless the task is already in the expected status. */
101:     private boolean guard(HttpServletResponse resp, String current, String expected, String action)
102:             throws IOException {
103:         if (!expected.equals(current)) {
104:             resp.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_CONFLICT,
105:                     "Cannot " + action + " a task in status " + current + " (expected " + expected + ")");
106:             return false;
107:         }
108:         return true;
109:     }

13: public class TaskDao {
14: 
15:     private static final String BASE =
16:         "SELECT t.id, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.priority, t.assignee_id, " +
17:         "       t.project_id, t.due_date, t.updated_at, a.full_name AS assignee_name, p.name AS project_name " +
18:         "FROM task t " +
19:         "JOIN project p ON p.id = t.project_id " +
20:         "LEFT JOIN person a ON a.id = t.assignee_id";
21: 
22:     public List<Task> findAll() {
23:         return run(BASE + " ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC");
24:     }
25: 
26:     public Task findById(long id) {
27:         List<Task> rows = runWith(BASE + " WHERE t.id = ?", id);
28:         return rows.isEmpty() ? null : rows.get(0);
29:     }
30: 
31:     public List<Task> findByProject(long projectId) {
32:         return runWith(BASE + " WHERE t.project_id = ? ORDER BY t.id", projectId);
33:     }
34: 
35:     /**
36:      * Finds tasks; the status and assignee filters are optional and the WHERE
37:      * clause is assembled dynamically. Values are parameterized; only the sort
38:      * column is concatenated (whitelisted), the classic legacy shortcut.
39:      */
40:     public List<Task> search(String status, Long assigneeId, String sort) {
41:         StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder(BASE);
42:         List<Object> params = new ArrayList<>();
43:         List<String> where = new ArrayList<>();
44:         if (status != null && !status.isEmpty()) {
45:             where.add("t.status = ?");
46:             params.add(status);
47:         }
48:         if (assigneeId != null) {
49:             where.add("t.assignee_id = ?");
50:             params.add(assigneeId);
51:         }
52:         if (!where.isEmpty()) {
53:             sql.append(" WHERE ").append(String.join(" AND ", where));
54:         }
55:         // Whitelist the sort expression to avoid injection via the concatenation.
56:         sql.append(" ORDER BY ").append(orderClause(sort));
57: 
58:         try (Connection c = Database.getConnection();
59:              PreparedStatement ps = c.prepareStatement(sql.toString())) {
60:             for (int i = 0; i < params.size(); i++) {
61:                 ps.setObject(i + 1, params.get(i));
62:             }
63:             try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
64:                 List<Task> out = new ArrayList<>();
65:                 while (rs.next()) {
66:                     out.add(map(rs));
67:                 }
68:                 return out;
69:             }
70:         } catch (SQLException e) {
71:             throw new RuntimeException(e);
72:         }
73:     }
74: 
75:     public long create(Task t) {
76:         String sql = "INSERT INTO task (title, description, status, priority, assignee_id, project_id, due_date) " +
77:                      "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";
78:         try (Connection c = Database.getConnection();
79:              PreparedStatement ps = c.prepareStatement(sql, PreparedStatement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {
80:             ps.setString(1, t.getTitle());

- Exempt: path `/login`, paths starting `/api/`, paths ending `.css` → no auth needed.

- GET /login → 200, login form (login.jsp).
- POST /login with valid credentials → 302 to /tasks, session created.
- POST with invalid → forward to login.jsp with "Invalid credentials" (status 200).

**LogoutServlet**:
- GET /logout (auth required, since /logout is not exempt) → invalidates session → 302 /login. After logout, /tasks requires login again.

**TaskListServlet**:
- GET /tasks (auth) → 200 tasks.jsp with all tasks ordered updated_at DESC by default.
- Filters: status, assignee; sort whitelist: status, priority (HIGH>MEDIUM>LOW), due/due_date, title, id, default/updated → updated_at DESC.
- `Long.valueOf(assigneeParam)` — NumberFormatException for malformed assignee → 500.
- Note: `status` filter with garbage value returns empty list (no rows match).
- Interesting: unknown sort token falls back to updated_at DESC (default). Not an error.

- GET /tasks/form (auth) → blank form, 200. With ?id=1 → prefilled, "Task #1: ...". With ?id=999 → `tasks.findById(999)` returns null, so req.setAttribute("task", null) — renders blank "New task" form! Actually `task` attribute is null → `not empty task` false → New task. Also `Long.parseLong("abc")` → 500.
- POST /tasks/form:
  - title empty (null or blank after trim) → forward with error "Title is required", 200, no DB mutation.
  - projectId null/empty/malformed/nonexistent → error "A task must belong to an existing project", 200, no mutation. Note: Long.parseLong happens BEFORE exists check → malformed "abc" → 500 error. Nonexistent 999 → error message.

from tests.helpers import MEMBER, TrackerTestCase, sql


def projects_table():
    raw = sql("SELECT id || '|' || name || '|' || state || '|' || owner_id || '|' || "
              "coalesce(description, 'NULL') FROM project ORDER BY id")
    table = {}
    for line in raw.splitlines():
        pid, name, state, owner, description = line.split("|", 4)
        table[int(pid)] = {"name": name, "state": state, "owner_id": int(owner),
                           "description": None if description == "NULL" else description}
    return table

    def test_s_proj_001_projects_page_lists_seeded_projects_ordered_by_name(self):
        """S-PROJ-001 — GET /projects lists all seeded projects in name order with state and owner."""
        r = self.client.login(MEMBER)
        self.assertEqual(302, r.status)
        page = self.client.get("/projects")
        self.assertEqual(200, page.status)
        self.assertIn("Apollo", page.body)
        self.assertIn("Borealis", page.body)
        self.assertIn("Legacy Archive", page.body)
        i_apollo = page.body.index("Apollo")
        i_borealis = page.body.index("Borealis")
        i_legacy = page.body.index("Legacy Archive")
        self.assertLess(i_apollo, i_borealis)
        self.assertLess(i_borealis, i_legacy)
        self.assertIn("ARCHIVED", page.body)

    def test_s_proj_002_projects_page_marks_archived_project_without_archive_button(self):
        """S-PROJ-002 — The projects page shows the Archive action only for ACTIVE projects."""
        self.client.login(MEMBER)
        page = self.client.get("/projects")
        rows = page.body.split("<tr>")
        archived_row = next(row for row in rows if "Legacy Archive" in row)
        active_row = next(row for row in rows if "Apollo" in row)
        self.assertNotIn('value="archive"', archived_row)
        self.assertIn('value="archive"', active_row)

    """Happy-path transitions OPEN → IN_PROGRESS → PENDING_APPROVAL → DONE → OPEN."""

        """S-ACT-001 — action=start on an OPEN task persists IN_PROGRESS and redirects to /tasks."""

        self.assertEqual(302, r.status)
        self.assertTrue(r.location.endswith("/tasks"), r.location)
        self.assertEqual("IN_PROGRESS", tasks_table()[1]["status"])

    def test_s_act_002_submit_moves_in_progress_task_to_pending_approval(self):
        """S-ACT-002 — action=submit on an IN_PROGRESS task persists PENDING_APPROVAL."""
        self.client.login()
        r = self.client.post("/tasks/action", {"id": 2, "action": "submit"})
        self.assertEqual(302, r.status)
        self.assertEqual("PENDING_APPROVAL", tasks_table()[2]["status"])

    def test_s_act_003_approve_moves_pending_task_to_done(self):
        """S-ACT-003 — action=approve by an approver on a PENDING_APPROVAL task persists DONE."""

        r = self.client.post("/tasks/action", {"id": 3, "action": "approve"})
        self.assertEqual(302, r.status)
        self.assertEqual("DONE", tasks_table()[3]["status"])

    def test_s_act_004_reject_moves_pending_task_back_to_in_progress(self):
        """S-ACT-004 — action=reject by an approver on a PENDING_APPROVAL task persists IN_PROGRESS."""
        self.client.login(MANAGER)
        r = self.client.post("/tasks/action", {"id": 3, "action": "reject"})
        self.assertEqual(302, r.status)
        self.assertEqual("IN_PROGRESS", tasks_table()[3]["status"])

    def test_s_act_005_reopen_moves_done_task_back_to_open(self):
        """S-ACT-005 — action=reopen on a DONE task persists OPEN."""

        self.assertEqual(302, r.status)
        self.assertEqual("OPEN", tasks_table()[4]["status"])

    def test_s_act_006_full_lifecycle_walk_persists_each_step(self):

            self.assertEqual(expected, tasks_table()[1]["status"], action)

        self.assertNotEqual(before, after)
        self.assertEqual("IN_PROGRESS", after["status"])

        self.assertEqual(302, r.status)
        self.assertTrue(r.location.endswith("/tasks/form?id=1"), r.location)

"""Generate reports/tests/mapping.json from the test suite docstrings.

Every test's docstring must begin with its provisional EARS id

import json
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

OUTPUTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(OUTPUTS))

FAMILY_BY_PREFIX = {
    "AUTH": "authentication/session/logout/access exemptions",

    "LIST": "task status-assignee filters and every whitelisted/default sort",
    "API": "public JSON API readback/filter/escaping/nulls",
}

    "AUTH": ["src/main/java/com/acme/tracker/web/AuthFilter.java",
             "src/main/java/com/acme/tracker/web/LoginServlet.java",
             "src/main/java/com/acme/tracker/web/LogoutServlet.java",

             "src/main/webapp/WEB-INF/jsp/tasks.jsp"],
    "API": ["src/main/java/com/acme/tracker/web/ApiTaskServlet.java"],

def walk(suite):
    for item in suite:
        if isinstance(item, unittest.TestSuite):
            yield from walk(item)
        else:

def main():
    suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover(str(OUTPUTS / "tests"))

            "statement": first,

                 "analyst rule ids are pending; reconcile when the orchestrator "
                 "passes accepted analyst ids. kind=characterization marks "
                 "observed-behavior cases labelled separately from intended "
                 "requirements."),
        "families": FAMILY_BY_PREFIX,
        "testCount": len(entries),
        "unmapped": [e["test"] for e in missing],
        "tests": entries,
    }
    out = OUTPUTS / "reports/tests/mapping.json"
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(json.dumps(mapping, indent=2) + "\n")
    print("mapped %d tests (%d unmapped) -> %s" % (len(entries), len(missing), out))
    if missing:

# d002 summary — test-engineer, run 05: fresh whole-app suite

## What was done
Built a from-scratch unittest suite for the frozen app (commit eee783057ec28d28fb36ec05484de9b4b40ceb9c) in the four dispatched family batches, all real HTTP sessions plus read-only SQL assertions against the seeded DB. Per-test DB reset (schema+seed reload, ~0.3s each) keeps tests isolated, deterministic, and fast.

## Commands (from ~/outputs)
- `python3 harness/runtime.py start` → Ready: http://127.0.0.1:8080
- `python3 harness/runtime.py reset` → 4 tasks
- `python3 tests/build_mapping.py` → mapped 129 tests (0 unmapped)
- `python3 harness/runtime.py test` → **Ran 129 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors — OK** (exit 0, ~23s)
- `python3 harness/runtime.py coverage` → BRANCH 168/188, LINE 452/500, INSTRUCTION 1993/2155, METHOD 103/108, CLASS 17/17

## Files committed (branch cs-sandbox/test-engineer-36f5ca10.task-tracker-05-36f5ca10, base 8f713fe)
- `tests/helpers.py` — HTTP client (no auto-redirect, cookie sessions), `fixture`/`sql`/`reset_db` via the harness's podman/psql path
- `tests/test_auth.py` (22, batch 1) + `tests/test_projects.py` (14, batch 1)
- `tests/test_task_form.py` (24, batch 2)
- `tests/test_task_actions.py` (20, batch 3) + `tests/test_bulk_close.py` (9, batch 3)
- `tests/test_task_list.py` (26, batch 4) + `tests/test_api.py` (14, batch 4)
- `tests/build_mapping.py` — generates `reports/tests/mapping.json` from docstrings so EARS ids can't drift
- `reports/tests/mapping.json` — all 129 tests → provisional EARS ids S-<FAMILY>-NNN, kind intended-requirement vs characterization
- `reports/coverage/` — JaCoCo HTML/XML/summary.json
- `findings/d002-test-engineer-findings.md`

## Refusals asserted without mutation
Unauthenticated access to every protected route (302→/login, DB unchanged), approve/reject by MEMBER/VIEWER (403), wrong-state transitions (409), unknown/missing actions (400), blank titles and missing/unknown projects (error page, row counts unchanged), bulkClose with no ids.

## Ordering assertions
Exact returned sequences asserted for the default (updated DESC: 4,3,2,1) and every whitelisted sort token — updated, status (4,2,1,3), priority HIGH>MEDIUM>LOW (2,1,3,4), due + due_date with NULLS LAST (3,1,2,4), title (4,1,3,2), id (1,2,3,4) — plus post-mutation reordering.

## Findings for the orchestrator (details + coverage gaps in findings/d002-test-engineer-findings.md)
1. Defect candidate: projects page Delete link targets unmapped `/projects/delete` (404).
2. Defect candidate: stored XSS — task titles rendered unescaped by list/form JSPs; JSON escaper passes `<>&` through.
3. Ambiguity: unknown `sort` token silently falls back to default order (S-LIST-009).
4. Defect candidates: user-reachable 500s on malformed ids/assignee/dueDate (NumberFormat/IllegalArgumentException) and on nonexistent assigneeId (FK).
5. GET /tasks/form?id=999 renders blank "New task" form (no 404); POST with nonexistent id=999 answers 302 as if saved.
6. Remaining uncovered branches are unreachable-by-HTTP: SQLException catch blocks, `TaskDao.findByProject`/`ProjectDao.findById` (dead from HTTP surface), DAO-level defensive guards, filter/servlet lifecycle, esc(null).

## Provisional IDs
All EARS ids are provisional (S-AUTH/PROJ/FORM/ACT/BULK/LIST/API-NNN) derived from source; mapping.json is reconciliation-ready when analyst IDs arrive.

No app edits, no POM/build changes, no test deletions/skips.
